key_concepts: Biodiversity includes variety of living things and species in a given area
The Philippines is a biodiversity hotspot facing environmental destruction
Climate change, pollution, and extractive industries threaten biodiversity
High species diversity increases ecosystem productivity and sustainability
Species diversity increases probability of adaptation and survival in changing environment
Adaptation is a characteristic that improves an organism’s ability to survive
Organisms must adapt to survive and reproduce
Forms of adaptation include migration, hibernation, structural adaptation, camouflage, and
Camouflage allows animals to blend with surroundings while mimicry imitates other organism
If organisms cannot adapt to environmental changes, they may die or migrate
Biodiversity has aesthetic and economic values
